reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 17(b) (p0118) gives Sparkling (our party) an unconditional right to terminate 'at any time' on ninety (90) days' written notice, with no cause trigger and no early-termination fee, penalty or forfeiture — squarely within the fallback (60–90 days' notice, fee cap not exceeded).
No Vendor convenience right appears in the cited provisions; termination is otherwise limited to insolvency/material default, so the walk-away trigger (Vendor convenience on <90 days) is absent.

The failed deterministic check ('Customer convenience termination present') is plausibly a keyword artefact — the clause lacks the labels 'for convenience'/'without cause' but is substantively an at-will right — and substance properly controls here.

Shortfalls against the preferred position (90 days rather than 30; no express pro-rata refund of prepaid fees in 17(b)) are correctly recorded as observations rather than escalated as deviations, consistent with the classification rules.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline and no counterparty comment were proposed; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs.
